messages:
alex: Pushed Amberjack v1 (per-channel int5 + block-bias-adapt) to staging for embeddings. Quick embed QA please.
priya: running recall@1,3,10 + silhouette + topk_entropy on prod-simset-40k. baseline = coral-emb-v1.
zhang: include multilingual slice and a short-query bucket (<7 tokens). freeze tokenizer v2.0 for parity.
eval-bot: Job 210900 queued by priya. model=amberjack-v1 dataset=prod-simset-40k seeds=4 microbatches=128.
priya: early scalars: global recall@1 -0.6% abs vs baseline; short recall@1 -3.2% abs; recall@10 short -0.7%. silhouette_short -0.025.
mira: short hit is concerning. can we dump 12 failing short queries with top5 neighbors? want to see if it's tie flips.
priya: sample dump:
q: "cancel my subscription"
baseline top1: "how to cancel subscription" (cos=0.90)
amberjack top1: "subscription refund policy" (cos=0.86)
amberjack top2: "how to cancel subscription" (cos=0.85)
=> mostly top1 swaps / near-paraphrases.
zhang: looks like margin compression on short queries. maybe block-bias-adapt not fully compensating. try postquant per-channel bias-corr patch.
alex: I also toggled KV-cache OFF on staging to reduce latency noise for these tests.
eval-bot: Patch test queued. Job 210901.
priya: with bias-corr: short recall@1 gap reduced 3.2% -> 0.9% abs. recall@3 nearly matched baseline.
mira: nice. what's perf / cost delta?
alex: cost down ~19% per token. p50 latency +4ms with cache off.
zhang: also tried selective-fp16 for projection layers: short gap ~0.5% but p50 +11ms. tradeoff noted.
priya: I computed centroid_shift for short cluster: amberjack -> baseline cosine centroid delta ~0.07. uMAPs show cluster preserved but shifted.
mira: topk_entropy increased by +0.08 bits for short bucket pre-bias-corr, reduced to +0.02 bits after bias-corr. good indicator.
alex: action items: 1) priya run 100k holdout for bias-corr and selective-fp16 branches; 2) zhang try stochastic-rounding seed sweep (3 seeds) on bias-corr build; 3) mira curate 30 qualitative fails for model card.
infra-bot: added canary fallback: fallback_model=coral-emb-v1 trigger_short_recall1_drop_pct=2.0 window_minutes=5.
priya: holdouts started: job 210902 (bias-corr 100k) and 210903 (selective-fp16 100k). ETA ~55m.
zhang: small note: there are ~18 punctuation-only short queries that inflate variance. filtering them shrinks short gap by ~0.35% abs. recommend excluding from SLOs.
mira: include pairwise-angle hist and norm_var in holdout metrics. monitor for norm_var increase >10% on short bucket.
priya: will attach cosine-delta heatmap and uMAPs to the ticket when done.
alex: if either branch yields recall@1 gap <=1.5% and cost reduction >=15%, we can canary with fallback + 24h norm monitor.
mira: also add rollback playbook and a quick script to swap in fallback model via API.
infra-bot: reminder: when canaryed, enable realtime alerting for short_recall1 and topk_entropy deltas.
priya: noted. will post final holdout numbers here. keeping thread for follow-ups only. :thumbsup:
